meaning.en: Treating things unevenly, stressing one side and neglecting the other.
meaning.zh: 指对事物轻重不当，偏重一方，处理不公平。

examples.zh: 对待两个孩子不能畸轻畸重。
examples.en: Parents mustn't favour one child over the other.

examples.zh: 预算分配畸轻畸重，教育经费严重不足。
examples.en: The budget was lopsided, leaving education badly underfunded.

examples.zh: 评价标准畸轻畸重，难以服众。
examples.en: The evaluation criteria were uneven and failed to convince.

usage.en: Predicate; often 不能畸轻畸重.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“不能畸轻畸重”。

natural: timely snow promises a good harvest

meaning.en: A good fall of winter snow foretells a plentiful harvest.
meaning.zh: 冬天适时下大雪，预示来年庄稼丰收。

equivalents: a good snowfall means a good harvest

examples.zh: 俗话说瑞雪兆丰年，今年的收成一定不错。
examples.en: As the saying goes, auspicious snow foretells a good year, so the harvest should be fine.

examples.zh: 新年下了场大雪，瑞雪兆丰年，大家都很高兴。
examples.en: A heavy snow fell at New Year; everyone was glad, for it promises a good harvest.

examples.zh: 看着漫天飞雪，老农笑着说瑞雪兆丰年。
examples.en: Watching the snow swirl, the old farmer said with a smile that it was a good-harvest omen.

usage.en: Farmers' proverb; sometimes a New Year wish.

meaning.en: The Confucian way of moderation, avoiding extremes.
meaning.zh: 儒家的处世原则，指待人处事不偏不倚、适度而行。

examples.zh: 孔子提倡中庸之道。
examples.en: Confucius advocated the doctrine of the mean.

examples.zh: 他处事讲究中庸之道，从不走极端。
examples.en: He handles things by the middle way and never goes to extremes.

examples.zh: 管理需要中庸之道，宽严相济。
examples.en: Management needs the middle way, balancing leniency and strictness.

story.en: Confucius: 'Is not the mean a supreme virtue? Yet few among the people have long possessed it' (中庸之为德也，其至矣乎！民鲜久矣).
story.zh: 《论语·雍也》：“中庸之为德也，其至矣乎！民鲜久矣。”

usage.en: Noun; sometimes mildly critical of fence-sitting.
usage.zh: 名词，有时略带批评，指无原则调和。

natural: discard the dross, keep the essence

meaning.en: To discard the crude and retain the best.
meaning.zh: 去掉粗劣的，留取精华。

equivalents: separate the wheat from the chaff

examples.zh: 整理资料时要去粗取精。
examples.en: When sorting material, discard the dross and keep the best.

examples.zh: 对传统文化应当去粗取精。
examples.en: Traditional culture should be sifted, keeping its essence.

examples.zh: 编辑对稿件去粗取精，只留最好的。
examples.en: The editor sifted the manuscript, keeping only the best.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 去伪存真.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“去伪存真”连用。

meaning.en: Evergreen pines and cypresses.
meaning.zh: 青翠的松树和柏树，常象征坚贞和长寿。

examples.zh: 陵园里苍松翠柏，庄严肃穆。
examples.en: In the cemetery, green pines and cypresses stand solemn and still.

examples.zh: 山上苍松翠柏，四季常青。
examples.en: The mountain is covered with evergreen pines and cypresses.

examples.zh: 古寺掩映在苍松翠柏之间。
examples.en: The old temple is half hidden among pines and cypresses.

usage.en: Noun phrase; often symbolic of steadfastness.
usage.zh: 名词性，常象征坚贞不屈。

meaning.en: A profoundly true and well-known saying.
meaning.zh: 最正确、最有道理而又广为人知的话。

examples.zh: “业精于勤”是一句至理名言。
examples.en: 'Diligence brings mastery' is a pearl of wisdom.

examples.zh: 他把这句至理名言写在了书桌上。
examples.en: He wrote this profound saying on his desk.

examples.zh: 古人的至理名言，至今仍有启发。
examples.en: The ancients' timeless sayings still inspire us today.

meaning.en: Rich natural produce and treasures; a land of abundant resources.
meaning.zh: 地上万物的精华就是上天的珍宝，指地方物产丰富、资源珍贵。

examples.zh: 这里物华天宝，人杰地灵。
examples.en: This land is rich in treasures and produces outstanding people.

examples.zh: 江南物华天宝，自古繁华。
examples.en: Jiangnan, with its natural wealth, has been prosperous since ancient times.

examples.zh: 物华天宝的西南地区吸引了无数游客。
examples.en: The bounteous southwest attracts countless visitors.

story.en: Wang Bo's Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng: 'The splendour of things is the treasure of Heaven; the dragon's glow pierces the Ox and Dipper' (物华天宝，龙光射牛斗之墟；人杰地灵，徐孺下陈蕃之榻).
story.zh: 王勃《滕王阁序》：“物华天宝，龙光射牛斗之墟；人杰地灵，徐孺下陈蕃之榻。”

usage.en: Often paired with 人杰地灵; used in praising a place.
usage.zh: 常与“人杰地灵”连用，称赞一地。

meaning.en: Delighted because the result exceeds one's expectations.
meaning.zh: 结果超出原来的期望，因而特别高兴。

examples.zh: 听说自己获奖，他大喜过望。
examples.en: Hearing he'd won a prize, he was overjoyed.

examples.zh: 本以为要赔钱，结果还赚了，真是大喜过望。
examples.en: He expected a loss but made a profit, which delighted him beyond his hopes.

examples.zh: 孩子们收到礼物，个个大喜过望。
examples.en: Every child was overjoyed on receiving a present.

story.en: Ying Bu, expecting a humble reception, found his lodgings as lavish as the king's and was overjoyed beyond his hopes (大喜过望).
story.zh: 《史记·黥布列传》：“布大怒，悔来，欲自杀。出就舍，帐御饮食从官如汉王居，布又大喜过望。”

meaning.en: To finish a task carelessly and hastily.
meaning.zh: 草率马虎地把事情应付过去。

examples.zh: 作业要认真写，不能草草了事。
examples.en: Do your homework properly, not in a slapdash way.

examples.zh: 他对待工作草草了事，难怪出错。
examples.en: He does his work half-heartedly, no wonder it goes wrong.

examples.zh: 他草草了事地结束了会议。
examples.en: He wrapped up the meeting perfunctorily.

usage.en: Predicate; usually 不能/不要草草了事.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“不要草草了事”。

meaning.en: To comply with someone's wishes in everything.
meaning.zh: 什么都依从、顺着对方。

examples.zh: 他对妻子百依百顺。
examples.en: He yields to his wife in everything.

examples.zh: 父母对独生女百依百顺，把她宠坏了。
examples.en: The parents indulged their only daughter's every whim and spoiled her.

examples.zh: 百依百顺的下属不一定是好下属。
examples.en: A subordinate who always obeys isn't necessarily a good one.

usage.en: Predicate; can be affectionate or critical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，可含亲昵或批评。

meaning.en: To do evil in many ways.
meaning.zh: 做了很多坏事。

examples.zh: 这个作恶多端的团伙终于被抓获。
examples.en: This gang that committed endless crimes was finally caught.

examples.zh: 他作恶多端，最终受到了法律的制裁。
examples.en: He did evil in countless ways and was finally punished by law.

examples.zh: 作恶多端的人必遭报应。
examples.en: Those who do much evil will be repaid.

antonyms: 勿以恶小而为之，勿以善小而不为

meaning.en: To indulge in wild, unrealistic fantasies.
meaning.zh: 思想进入虚幻的境界，指胡思乱想，不切实际。

examples.zh: 别想入非非了，先把眼前的事做好。
examples.en: Stop dreaming and do what's in front of you.

examples.zh: 看到一张纸条，他就想入非非。
examples.en: One slip of paper set his imagination running wild.

examples.zh: 她对未来想入非非，却不愿付出努力。
examples.en: She daydreams about the future but won't put in the effort.

meaning.en: Outstanding and different from the ordinary.
meaning.zh: 才德超群，与众不同。

equivalents: in a class of one's own

examples.zh: 他才华横溢，卓尔不群。
examples.en: Brilliantly talented, he stands apart from the crowd.

examples.zh: 她以卓尔不群的气质赢得了大家的尊重。
examples.en: Her distinctive bearing won everyone's respect.

examples.zh: 卓尔不群的人往往不容易被理解。
examples.en: Those who stand out are often hard to understand.

meaning.en: Having both wisdom and courage.
meaning.zh: 既有智谋，又有勇气。

examples.zh: 这位将军智勇双全，战无不胜。
examples.en: The general had both brains and courage and was never beaten.

examples.zh: 消防员智勇双全，成功救出被困者。
examples.en: The firefighter showed wit and courage in rescuing the trapped people.

examples.zh: 他是个智勇双全的好队长。
examples.en: He's a captain with both brains and bravery.

meaning.en: A talented young man and a beautiful young woman; the stock lovers of romances.
meaning.zh: 有才华的男子和美丽的女子，多指古典小说中的恋人。

equivalents: the gifted scholar and the beauty

examples.zh: 这出戏讲的是才子佳人的故事。
examples.en: This play tells a story of a gifted scholar and a beauty.

examples.zh: 才子佳人的结局往往是大团圆。
examples.en: Tales of scholars and beauties usually end happily.

examples.zh: 他们被称为一对才子佳人。
examples.en: They're called a perfect pair of talent and beauty.

usage.zh: 名词性，常见于文学作品。

meaning.en: Gentle, polite and well-mannered.
meaning.zh: 举止文雅，很有礼貌。

examples.zh: 他长得斯斯文文，说话也很客气。
examples.en: He looks gentle and speaks politely.

examples.zh: 斯斯文文的女孩子也有倔强的一面。
examples.en: Even a refined girl can have a stubborn side.

examples.zh: 吃饭要斯斯文文的，别狼吞虎咽。
examples.en: Eat politely, don't wolf your food.

natural: be glad to be told one's faults

meaning.en: To be glad when one's faults are pointed out.
meaning.zh: 听到别人指出自己的过错就高兴，形容虚心接受批评。

equivalents: be glad to hear one's faults

examples.zh: 好领导要闻过则喜，从善如流。
examples.en: A good leader welcomes criticism and follows good advice.

examples.zh: 他闻过则喜，常请同事指出不足。
examples.en: He welcomes criticism and often asks colleagues to point out his shortcomings.

examples.zh: 做人要有闻过则喜的胸怀。
examples.en: One should have the breadth of mind to welcome correction.

story.en: Mencius: 'When Zilu was told he had made a mistake, he was glad' (子路，人告之以有过，则喜).
story.zh: 《孟子·公孙丑上》：“子路，人告之以有过，则喜。”

meaning.en: Walking with long, quick strides.
meaning.zh: 形容走路步子大，速度快。

examples.zh: 他大步流星地走进了会议室。
examples.en: He strode briskly into the meeting room.

examples.zh: 教练大步流星冲上场去。
examples.en: The coach strode quickly onto the pitch.

examples.zh: 她大步流星，我几乎跟不上。
examples.en: She walked at such a pace I could hardly keep up.

pinyin: kě wàng ér bù kě jí
literal: can · gaze · but · not · can · reach
natural: in sight but out of reach

meaning.en: Visible but unattainable.
meaning.zh: 能看到却无法接近或得到。

equivalents: so near and yet so far

examples.zh: 名校对他来说可望而不可即。
examples.en: A top university was beyond his reach.

examples.zh: 这套房子价格太高，可望而不可即。
examples.en: The flat was priced too high, in sight but out of reach.

examples.zh: 成功看似可望而不可即，其实只差一步。
examples.en: Success seemed out of reach, but it was only a step away.

natural: the tail too big to wag

meaning.en: Subordinates become too powerful for the leadership to control.
meaning.zh: 尾巴太大不易摇动，比喻下属势力强大，指挥不灵。

examples.zh: 藩镇割据，尾大不掉，朝廷无力控制。
examples.en: The provincial warlords grew too strong for the court to control.

examples.zh: 机构臃肿，尾大不掉，改革十分困难。
examples.en: With the organisation bloated and unwieldy, reform is difficult.

examples.zh: 子公司势力膨胀，尾大不掉。
examples.en: The subsidiaries grew so powerful that the head office could not control them.

story.en: Zuo Zhuan: 'When the tip is too big it must break; when the tail is too big it cannot be swung' (末大必折，尾大不掉).
story.zh: 《左传·昭公十一年》：“末大必折，尾大不掉，君所知也。”

usage.en: Predicate; formal, often in political or organisational contexts.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语，常用于政治或组织语境。

pinyin: shān yǔ yù lái fēng mǎn lóu
literal: mountain · rain · about to · come · wind · fills · tower
natural: wind fills the tower before the rain

meaning.en: The wind fills the tower as the mountain rain approaches; a sign that trouble is brewing.
meaning.zh: 山雨来临前，风已吹满高楼，比喻重大事件发生前的紧张气氛。

examples.zh: 会议前气氛紧张，真是山雨欲来风满楼。
examples.en: With tension high before the meeting, a storm was clearly brewing.

examples.zh: 市场异动频繁，山雨欲来风满楼。
examples.en: With the market so volatile, trouble is clearly on the way.

examples.zh: 边境局势山雨欲来风满楼。
examples.en: The situation on the border is ominous, with a storm gathering.

story.en: Xu Hun's poem on the Tower East of Xianyang: 'Clouds rise from the stream, the sun sinks behind the pavilion; mountain rain is about to come and wind fills the tower' (溪云初起日沉阁，山雨欲来风满楼).
story.zh: 许浑《咸阳城东楼》：“溪云初起日沉阁，山雨欲来风满楼。”

usage.en: Often used as a standalone remark.

meaning.en: Sturdy, lively and cute (of a boy).
meaning.zh: 形容孩子长得健壮憨厚，招人喜爱。

examples.zh: 他有个虎头虎脑的小外孙。
examples.en: He has a sturdy, lively little grandson.

examples.zh: 这孩子虎头虎脑的，人见人爱。
examples.en: The boy is sturdy and adorable, loved by all.

examples.zh: 虎头虎脑的小男孩在院子里跑来跑去。
examples.en: The sturdy little boy ran about the yard.

usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，形容孩子。

meaning.en: Staying calm whether praised or humiliated.
meaning.zh: 受宠或受辱都不动心，形容心态平和。

equivalents: calm in good times and bad

examples.zh: 他宠辱不惊，始终保持平常心。
examples.en: Unmoved by praise or blame, he kept an even mind throughout.

examples.zh: 成功时不骄，失败时不馁，做到宠辱不惊。
examples.en: Not proud in success nor downcast in failure: unmoved by favour or disgrace.

examples.zh: 宠辱不惊是一种难得的修养。
examples.en: Equanimity under praise and blame is a rare quality.

synonyms: 回首向来萧瑟处，归去，也无风雨也无晴
